tasks_completed.description: Removed borderBottomLeftRadius, borderBottomRightRadius, and overflow:'hidden' from container style
tasks_completed.changes: Removed borderBottomLeftRadius: 11, borderBottomRightRadius: 11, overflow: 'hidden' from container style object
tasks_completed.rationale: overflow:hidden on the container was clipping the horizontal scrollbar into the rounded corner area, causing it to overlap with the moreContainer text. For short output, the clipped corners looked bad.

tasks_completed.description: Added borderBottomLeftRadius and borderBottomRightRadius to moreContainer style
tasks_completed.changes: Added borderBottomLeftRadius: 11, borderBottomRightRadius: 11 to moreContainer style
tasks_completed.rationale: When '+N more lines' is shown, the moreContainer is the bottom-most element and should have the rounded corners. For short output without moreContainer, the parent ToolView's borderRadius + overflow:hidden handles corners.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - CSS layout issue from original implementation
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Container had overflow:hidden + borderRadius which clipped scrollbar and caused visual artifacts
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Moved border radius to the actual bottom element (moreContainer) and removed overflow:hidden so scrollbar renders properly

dev.qa_notes: Verify in browser: (1) Long bash output with scrollbar should not overlap '+N more lines' text. (2) Short bash output should have clean rounded bottom corners from parent ToolView. Test on both desktop and mobile viewports.
